title: Backend Engineer
text:
We are hiring a senior Backend Engineer to work on systems that are already in production and already load-bearing. You will own services end to end: design, ship, operate, and answer the pager for them.

You will be expected to reason carefully about memory and resource behaviour — memory, gc, leak.

You will be expected to reason carefully about pagination and large result sets — pagination, cursor, api.

You will be expected to reason carefully about data structure selection — data structure, algorithm, hashmap.

You will be expected to reason carefully about schema migrations — migration, zero downtime, deploy.

You will be expected to reason carefully about transactions and isolation — transaction, acid, isolation.

You will be expected to reason carefully about http and rest semantics — api, rest, http.

You will be expected to reason carefully about refactoring and code health — refactor, maintainability, code quality.

You will be expected to reason carefully about locking and coordination — lock, mutex, synchronisation.

You will be expected to reason carefully about logging — logging, logs, observability.

You will be expected to reason carefully about consistency models — distributed, consistency, replication.

You will be expected to reason carefully about cache invalidation — cache, redis, invalidation.

You will be expected to reason carefully about backpressure and flow control — backpressure, throughput, lag.

We care much more about how you think through an unfamiliar problem than about which frameworks appear on your CV. Expect the interview to be technical and specific.
